reference.host: Apple M6, 24 GB RAM, 12 GPU cores
reference.display: LG HDR 4K, awake main display, 60 Hz; macOS built-in Apple M6 GPU inventory

strata.fresh-process-warm-resource-cache: new browser process and workers; browser resource cache may already be primed
strata.reload-new-workers-warm-resource-cache: same browser process, reloaded page and new workers; resource cache remains warm
strata.cold-network: fresh Chromium process/context; context-wide no-cache routing bypasses browser and job-local Pyodide cache interception; CDN edge may already have the object
strata.reused-healthy-interpreter: same page and Python worker; a second Run uses the same pristine interpreter generation after a completed eligible source execution

measurementDefinitions.runAcceptedAt: Page epoch timestamp when the current Run is accepted, before clientForRun/interpreter preparation; time queued before page acceptance, including click/dispatch delay, is excluded. sourceRunStartedAt remains the later source-invocation origin used to join causal publications.
measurementDefinitions.firstUsefulMs: Elapsed from accepted Run to completion of the first canvas screenshot containing at least 128 scene-ink pixels.
measurementDefinitions.firstPresentedMs: Elapsed from accepted Run or replay restart to a matching Noon renderer presentation receipt; the timestamp is an observer upper bound, not GPU completion or physical scanout.
measurementDefinitions.firstSubmittedMs: Elapsed from accepted Run to the first renderer.render() call completion. This is an upper bound on earlier backend frame submission and the Noon presentation receipt; it is not exact queue-submit start, GPU completion, or physical scanout.
measurementDefinitions.firstControlsReady: Elapsed from accepted Run to an enabled playback toggle observed with a matching current-run presentation.
measurementDefinitions.commandAcceptance: Elapsed time from the actual DOM request event to endpoint acceptedEpochMs sampled after the Rust mutation.
measurementDefinitions.commandPresentation: Elapsed time from the actual DOM request event to a command-correlated Noon presentation receipt; it does not measure physical scanout.
measurementDefinitions.readerLead: At each readiness observation, prepared reader lead is Rust frontier minus Rust observed reader time from one preparedPlayback state snapshot; it is not inferred from renderer time.
measurementDefinitions.buffering: Per-row prepared-reader waiting is reconstructed from Rust playing/buffering transitions at execution mutation boundaries; pauses are excluded. Episode duration is an observer-bound interval, and count, total and maximum are limited independently per row.
measurementDefinitions.activeFrameGaps: Successful continuous renderer presentation intervals fully inside the accepted-Run-to-first-traversal or restart-to-first-replay-wrap observation window, deduplicated by renderer interval ordinal. Renderer call timing is not physical scanout.
measurementDefinitions.missedRefreshFraction: Estimated missed nominal cadence opportunities divided by captured intervals plus estimated missed opportunities, using the declared refreshHz as a host cadence target; it is not a physical display refresh measurement.

failurePolicy: retain every attempt; missing identities, traces, samples or required arm results fail strict qualification

baselineEvidence.review: Coordinator-reviewed C/D reference distributions and engineering targets; ready freezes the contract, not candidate qualification.

boundRationale.startup: Per-source/phase/stratum sample-p95 absolute ceilings plus A/C and B/D p95 <= reference*1.20+250 ms. Limits allow modest loading delay; screenshot-completion timing includes the capture cadence. Cold-network excludes CDN-edge coldness.
boundRationale.commands: Feedback p95 <=50 ms; runtime acceptance and matching presentation p95 <=100 ms; matching presentation p99 <=200 ms. Apply with preparation active and independently to completed-history seeks.
boundRationale.cadence: At 60 Hz, p99 <= two nominal intervals, <=2% estimated missed opportunities, and no renderer interval >250 ms. The reference 371 ms outlier exceeds the chosen stall target and remains recorded.
boundRationale.buffering: Both ordinary and dense prefix playback permit at most two brief waits, each <=250 ms and <=500 ms total per run. These are UX targets, not derived from candidate diagnostics or the inapplicable C/D prefix path.
boundRationale.memory: Paired-run sampled process-tree RSS p95 <=2.25 GiB; every worker retires within a 1000 ms observer upper bound including a fixed 750 ms tail. Existing logical category caps and separate owner/capacity diagnostics remain required; RSS is not total GPU or live retained bytes.
